title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. The notes study the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}. The method is to dissect a smooth analytic space X (in the intended case the Deligne–Mumford–Knudsen compactification) along a normal crossings divisor D into 'pieces of construction', each described up to homotopy. The previous page proposed a heuristic 'homeomorphism' (292) and then a homotopy equivalence (294) between a piece V^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0} and a space Ň^*_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)}|D^*_{d_*}. Grothendieck noted that this equivalence corresponds to no canonical arrow in either direction.

This page is a 'Scholie important' summarising what the pieces are, up to homotopy.

1. Indexing. The open strata are D^*_{d_*} = D^*_{(d_0,…,d_r)}, indexed by finite sequences of depths. These are smooth analytic spaces, locally closed in D_{d_0}.

2. Normal bundle. Over the stratum D^*_{d_*} one takes the normal bundle Ň of D^*_{d_*} relative to D^*_{d_*} → D_{d_0}. This is a vector bundle that splits locally into line bundles, one for each local branch of D through the stratum; this is 'a fibration of type d_0'.

3. Sub-bundle. One takes a sub-bundle Ň = Ň_{d_*,(d'_0,d''_0)} attached to a choice of branches (d'_0 branches with d''_0 of them singled out). Removing the coordinate hyperplanes gives Ň^*.

4. Result. Ň^* is a locally trivial fibre bundle over D^*_{d_*} with fibre (C^*)^{d'_0−d''_0}.

In modern terms: the deleted tubular neighbourhood of a stratum of a normal crossings divisor (more precisely, of the corresponding stratum of the boundary of the complement) is homotopy equivalent to a torus bundle over the open stratum. This is the bundle of nonzero vectors in the split normal bundle, or equivalently a real torus (S^1)^k-bundle. It is exactly what the Kato–Nakayama / real oriented blow-up gives at the corresponding corner.

The rotated marginal note seems to extend the statement to the 'open parts' over D_0^* and to the limit over D_0, though it is largely illegible.

The next page states the goal: a canonical equivalence of fundamental groupoids Π_1(Ň^*|D^*) ≃ Π_1(V), replacing the non-canonical homotopy equivalence. By the homotopy exact sequence of the torus bundle, π_1 of each component of Ň^* is an extension of π_1 of the corresponding component of the stratum by a quotient of Z^r, namely Z^r modulo the image of π_2 of the base. This is the input for gluing a 'Teichmüller tower at infinity' from local data at the boundary strata, i.e. tangential base points.
errors: The identification of the pieces V with Ň^*|D^* is explicitly heuristic and non-canonical (previous page). No proof is given that the dissection pieces are homotopy equivalent to the torus bundles, though this is standard via tubular neighbourhoods / real oriented blow-up.

The indexing (d'_0, d''_0) and the exact sub-bundle chosen are not made precise on this page. The fibre dimension d'_0−d''_0 is only consistent if the sub-bundle has rank d'_0−d''_0 with all coordinate hyperplanes removed. This is plausible but not verifiable from the page.

ideas.what: Pieces of the dissection of the complement of a normal crossings divisor are, up to homotopy, (C^*)^k-bundles over open strata, obtained from the split normal bundle with coordinate hyperplanes removed.
ideas.modern_name: Deleted tubular neighbourhoods of NCD strata; real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama space; boundary of the Harer/Borel–Serre-type bordification
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore (Mumford toroidal embeddings 1973; Deligne; Kato–Nakayama 1999 for the log version)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) sketches the 'structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν} and tangential base points but not this detail

ideas.what: Using these torus bundles to compare the fundamental groupoid at infinity (aiming at a canonical Π_1 equivalence; continued next page).
ideas.modern_name: Tangential base points; fundamental groupoid of the boundary of moduli of curves; Teichmüller tower at infinity
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (1989, tangential base points); Ihara–Nakamura; Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps; Grothendieck (Esquisse)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme, §§2–3 (Teichmüller tower, tangential base points), in outline

deep.surprise_reason: This page is a careful but standard working summary: neighbourhoods at infinity of NCD strata are homotopic to torus bundles. It belongs to Grothendieck's well-known program on the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν}, already outlined in the Esquisse and later developed via tangential base points by others. It shows how he organised the dissection, but contains nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 'le fibré … Ň_{d_*,|D^*_{d_0}} sur D^*_{d_*}' likely reads 'le fibré Ň_{d_*}|D^*_{d_*} sur D^*_{d_*}' (normal bundle restricted to the stratum), with a crossed-out word before Ň.
The parenthetical '(… partie finie … de N)' likely refers to strata indexed by a finite part / finite subset of ℕ (natural numbers), not Ň.
The struck word before 'général' (?) in 'on prend une [gradient?] …' appears to be crossed out, with a replacement word above; the reading is uncertain.
'(contenue dans D^*_{d_*})' is preceded by a crossed-out word ('restr…'?).
